actions.description: Select one sourced daily story or record NO_EDITION within the quality gates.
Write bilingual edition content that passes sourcing, copy, budget and quality checks.
Compose deterministic social drafts and place them in the draft-locked approval queue.
Turn an already approved sponsor slot on or off without accepting money or changing terms.
Choose among existing BoardlessAI layout variants, components and design tokens.
Approve any spend outside a recorded operating envelope before commitment.
Approve new dependencies, routes, sections, design tokens, CSP rules or headers.
Approve budget-cap, operating-cap or meeting-schedule changes.
Approve accounts, credentials, OAuth scopes or channel autopublish.
Approve each sponsor or revenue event after the hosting and brand gates clear.
Approve any DNESKAi code change; delivery may write content and board data only.

controls.description: Security headers and CSP may not be weakened through any board path.
The DNESKAi 110 kB page-entry gzip ceiling remains mandatory.
Accessibility checks remain mandatory for every public route and asset.
Sources, provenance, metrics, review status and costs must remain factual.
Only sanitized projections may reach a public site or delivery package.
Only the human owner may execute payments or accept money.
Routes, feeds, redirects, locales and the dispatches and wire keys stay compatible.
